description:
工作描述：
1)作为销售从事搅拌设备（搅拌机/搅拌器/泵/反应釜）的销售工作，为客户讲解技术方案；
2）针对客户需求，协调技术方案，并讲解设备的技术特点，回应客户疑问，与客户讨论技术及商务方案；
3）制作报价及合同文本，跟踪执行合同；
4）建立、管理、维护与客户的长期合作关系；
5）强调强烈的销售意愿和出差意愿（越南、中国）；
6）完成领导安排的其他工作；
加分项： 有中资企业工作经验的越南人优先，但此项不作为硬性要求，仅为加分项
薪资： 基本工资+绩效工资+销售提成
办公方式 ：混合的（办公室+远程办公）
Job Description:
1. Promote mixing equipment (mixers, agitators, pumps, reactors) and present technical solutions to clients.
2. Coordinate technical proposals based on customer needs, explain equipment features, and handle technical and commercial discussions.
3. Prepare quotations and contracts and follow up on execution.
4. Build and maintain long-term client relationships.
5. Strong sales motivation and willingness to travel (Vietnam and China).
6. Perform other duties as assigned by the manager.
A plus: Vietnamese candidates with work experience at a Chinese-funded company. Not mandatory.
Compensation: Base salary + performance-based pay + sales commission.
Office mode: Mixed (office+remote work)
